summary_text: Aspen Reyes was the type of person who'd blend into the background of a story with ease; they weren't particularly special except for their violent tendencies, which their school knew them for. Nova Jones was the school's most outgoing girl who went through a new boyfriend every week and lived for the drama and gossip. When the two meet, they absolutely hate each other: Aspen had even more violent tendencies around her compared to most people, and Nova was completely convinced that they were out to get her—which she wasn't exactly wrong about. As the two teenagers adapt to their first year of high school at Maple Coast Academy, they'll cross paths and start fights they won't be able to finish. At least, not in the way either of them expected to be finishing them.

summary_text: What if you were abducted from a life you had built for yourself and given a destiny you never asked for? What if they stole everything you had worked to become? Mara is a musician and teacher with a small, hard-won life. But now she has been summoned into the body of an idealized young man, with a magical icon of faith grafted into her flesh against her will. The leaders of the Solar Crown exalt her as their Goddess's chosen champion, while denying the person she spent years becoming. Cresse is demon-descended, a bloodline the Solar Crown despises. She was taken from her village at sixteen and bound in brass as property of the state. She wants her own strength, a sword, and the right to be admired as the statuesque beauty she had always meant to become. Each woman is a prisoner of the same hierarchy, from opposite sides. As their wary alliance becomes something deeper, they must contend with a world that polices who they are and whom they may love, and with an imposed magic that threatens to turn every request into a violation. Can they build a love that is chosen rather than owned, and will it shake the foundations of the Solar Crown?

summary_text: Breakfast is at seven. Agreement may take a little longer. Prague, 1931. Vienna Leary arrives at a boarding house with a computer that talks, an invitation to a symposium, and questions of her own. At the breakfast table are Aldous Huxley, Abraham Maslow and Eric Blair—the man who will become George Orwell. There is coffee. There are opinions. Nobody is likely to leave their assumptions undisturbed. As their encounters unfold across the decades, conversation turns to freedom, power, belonging and the difficult business of living well. Ideas meet ordinary experience; celebrated thinkers face awkward questions; and an artificial intelligence joins a discussion that began long before anyone imagined it could have a voice. Warm, wry and questioning, *Proclivities at Seven* is a novel of imagined encounters and lively disagreements. It brings famous minds into close company with a woman who respects their work and still wants to argue—and asks what all that thinking might mean when it comes time to live a life of one’s own.

summary_html:
She sets the table at midnight
Porcelain plates, one cracked in half
Silver knives lined like soldiers
Sugar bowl shaped like a calf
Smoke curls up from the teapot
Candles drip over the cards
Every flame leans toward her
Every shadow guards

The queen of hearts loves her tarts
But she eats them in the dark Count every crimson crumb
Like a promise, like a mark
The queen of hearts loves her tarts
But she saves the sweetest part
For the ones who break their word
She will carve it from their heart

 

Guests arrive through the mirror
Invited by whispers, not names
They sit down where chairs pull closer
Like they're tied to invisible chains
She smiles soft as lace now
Offers cherry, clove, and cream
Every bite tastes sweeter
Till the room begins to lean

summary_text: When Stella finally sees a home listed for a price she can actually afford, she goes after it without any hesitation. However, as a brand new homeowner of a dark estate, her excitement quickly fades as she starts seeing a mysterious man around the property. She can never seem to approach him or speak to him, but she's comforted by his warm presence and he starts appearing in her dreams. Her encounters with him start to fill her with intrigue and longing, rather than fear. As external circumstances lead Stella to spend more and more time alone at home, her connection to the mystery man deepens, and her friends and family start to worry as she starts to emotionally detach from the outside world. Follow Stella's journey into unraveling the secrets of the dark manor and mystery man, no matter the personal cost.

summary_text: Claire is the CEO of a huge hotel chain. At 24, she took over the position passed down to her by her own father and, ever since, has become known as his successor. To many, Claire is a woman completely devoted to her work, someone capable of spending days sleeping in her own office just to make sure everything is under control. But no one knows the things she hides. Elisabeth is 23 years old and lost her father when she was fifteen in a car accident that also left her mother in a coma. Ever since, she has held on to the hope that one day her mother will wake up. At 19, Elisabeth rented a small space and opened her own café. Since then, she has worked every day to keep it running and pay for her mother's expenses, while trying to build a life she never imagined she would have to live on her own. Their worlds cross in a way neither of them could have imagined. Elisabeth begins to discover more about the CEO everyone admires, but will she be able to see who Claire really is and still choose to stay by her side? And will Claire be able to protect Elisabeth without dragging her into the same hole she's trying to escape from?

summary_text: Born into the global powerhouse De Silva family, Jillian exists under a constant, crushing magnifying glass. Overlooked in favor of her older brother and her lifelong tormentor, Westin Rinaldi, Jillian often resorts to rebellion just to have a voice, only to be branded a disgrace. West, the arrogant, fiercely ambitious heir to the De Silvas' greatest ally, sees Jillian as a stain on their families' two-hundred-year legacy. Following the tragic death of his parents at 17, West moves into the De Silva estate to work alongside her father until he can take the helm of his own empire, making it his personal mission to push Jillian to stumble so she is hidden away for good. Her life is irrevocably changed by a disastrous teenage mistake, further driving her parents to favor West over her at every turn. But when a routine flight goes awry, Jillian and West find themselves stranded on an uninhabited island in the middle of the Atlantic. Forced to rely on each other for survival, they must navigate their deep-seated resentment and a shifting dynamic where hatred and unwanted proximity collide. Stranded together in the wilderness, they are forced to confront the buried truths that have been piling up for 20 years.

summary_text: Six years ago, Crown Prince Alexandros of Lycanthria disappeared, stolen from his kingdom by the very enemies who had threatened his kind for centuries. His mate, Cassian, was left behind with two newborn sons, a kingdom in mourning, and a bond that refused to break even when the wolf on the other end of it was gone. In his absence, Alexandros’s identical twin, Nikolai, took the throne, while Cassian built a quiet life with their children beyond the castle walls. When Alexandros finally returns, six years of captivity have left their marks. Though Lycanthria welcomes its lost prince, Cassian cannot help but wonder if the mate who stands before him is the same man he spent years mourning—or someone he must learn to love all over again. With two children who have never known their father and a bond that has endured more than either could have imagined, Alexandros and Cassian must face the distance between the lives they once shared and the lives they have built apart.

summary_text: Elysium was supposed to be dead. After the horrors of *Beautiful Salvation*, Priya Hassam thought she had finally escaped the world that once knew her as Roza. Now a second-year medical student, she's determined to reclaim her future, bury her past, and forget the man who once promised to protect her. But some empires refuse to stay buried. When a new, more sinister version of Elysium emerges beneath New York City's glittering elite, Priya is sent undercover to investigate. Behind its resurrection stand Christina and the mysterious Curator, whose ambitions extend far beyond trafficking bodies. They're building an empire where desire becomes obedience, captivity masquerades as freedom, and human lives are nothing more than collectibles. Her greatest complication? Karim Nassar. The ruthless embodiment of Greed wants her back, but Priya has no intention of surrendering her independence to another powerful man. As secrets unravel and old desires reignite, Priya discovers that Elysium's resurrection may have been orchestrated with her in mind. **Because the most beautiful things are often the hardest to possess. And Priya Hassan refuses to belong to anyone.**

summary_text: Russell has a terrible habit of lying through his teeth. David has the unique skill of seeing right through him. Russell is a transfer student at RBU, and though it is his first year, he has enough credits to be considered a Junior. Juniors, conveniently, do not need APs. If he were a betting man, Russell would have put money down on the certainty of him flying through his remaining years at RBU essentially scot-free. But when roommate troubles and past trauma begin to bubble over, he isn't so sure he can manage entirely alone. David has a keen eye for people in need of help, and an ear for picking up on lies. When he meets a boy so rigid in his own body, he fears he'll break, he can't help the curiosity forming. Russell is essentially a Psych students dream case study. It turns out that trauma is much different in reality than it is on paper, but he's determined to put in the effort to help Russell see the world in a better light.

summary_text: Eli Navarro thought surviving Elysium meant he could finally build a life with Viktor Morozov. A ring on his finger. Another year of medical school. A future that reaches beyond the next catastrophe. But grief follows them home, and the world Viktor rules has never learned to leave anything beautiful untouched. When a new enemy rises from Elysium’s ruins, Viktor begins to change. Tenderness gives way to distance. Familiar hands become impossible to trust. Then the man who promised Eli a lifetime disappears, leaving behind questions that threaten everything Eli believed about their love. Surrounded by dangerous allies and drawn toward an unexpected warmth, Eli must decide what devotion demands when staying hurts—and leaving might mean surrendering Viktor to something worse. Beneath the glitter of New York, old loyalties fracture, buried truths surface, and love becomes a weapon in someone else’s hands. Viktor has always been the one who came for him. This time, Eli must find his way into the darkness and bring him home. But saving the man he loves may mean facing what Viktor has become—and discovering how far he is willing to go without losing himself.

summary_text: This is the original script to the comic I'm working on, How to Sew a Dress. It's a feel good, slice of life type of story that centers around Sienna and her friends trying to get through an art academy for the elite. She's interested in fashion, hence the title. And has what can be described as an unwavering sense of confidence in herself. Her closest friend, Coraline, is also trying to get into the full tuition scholarship program, which is a completely new addition to the institution. This is a story about creating, the learning process, social inequities, perserverance and, overall, the love for these character's undying love for the arts. This work will later become a comic. I'm first posting it here mainly because I'd love to get as much reactions/critiques as I possibly can. It'd really help my writing process and overall experience publishing this work.

summary_text: Amidst the gravestones, vines, and trees, a gauntleted hand pushes out of the dirt. The rest of the body that scrambles out of the dirt is neither living or dead, human or hound, but something else entirely. Every inch of her body is painfully numb; like television static vibrating from within her bones. Her floppy sears that sag just above her forehead have shed their fur, showing signs of wear and tear beneath. Her eye sockets are dark and ringed, empty of any life, only showing a hint of its old intellect. Tattered white hair hangs dry from her scalp like a mass of fabric. Names, places, memories, beliefs; all of them have been replaced with a void where her heart used to be. Who… am I? What am I? A sword protrudes from the ground next to her illegible gravestone, and she pulls it free. Was this mine? *** An undead hound navigates a cult of survivors of the Hound Husk curse, sending them on missions across the timelines as amoral mercenaries and teaching pilots the ways of magic. Open to feedback!

For the first time in his life, Cael has something like a home: a cottage in the marsh, a mentor who's learning to be honest, and a routine measured in scraps and firelight. But something is stirring beneath the ruins. The wards are failing. A trader who hasn't been late in a decade is running out of time, and the thing the old empire buried under the world is starting to remember it's awake. Peace, it turns out, is just the space between storms. The next chapter of FoxTale. A slow-burning dark fantasy about the quiet work of survival, the debts we carry, and how much of yourself you can give away before there's nothing left to give. The sequel to Foxtale Vol. 1. But something is stirring beneath the ruins. The wards are failing. A trader who hasn't been late in a decade is running out of time, and the thing the old empire buried under the world is starting to remember it's awake.

Peace, it turns out, is just the space between storms.

The next chapter of FoxTale. A slow-burning dark fantasy about the quiet work of survival, the debts we carry, and how much of yourself you can give away before there's nothing left to give.

summary_html:
Willow Larsen is still inside her body when her sister’s sorority, the Vespers, sacrifices her in a ritual. She can see. She cannot leave. The thing they summoned for beauty and power sat down in the wrong sister and smiled.

Max Van Doren has been watching her for years. Childhood friend. Stranger. The boy she avoids in stairwells. The man the police keep missing. He finds her on the field‑station floor. He takes his mask off.

“Hello, Willow.”

He doesn’t run. He doesn’t save her. He takes both of them home and teaches the hungry thing wearing her how to hunt. Everyone who ever touched what belonged to him is next.

summary_text: Adrian Varga is the definition of a model student. Straight A's, an excellent athlete, an S-tier reputation and an enviable amount of wealth and status in his name. His whole future is mapped out, and all he has to do is maintain this plan, follow the path and not screw it up. Nothing and no one can get in his way. He must see anything hindering his success as a distraction and ignore his desires. Every year, month, week and day is an ongoing cycle. Wake up, eat, be perfect, sleep, and repeat. But this cycle soon breaks, and a new obstacle enters his path. Enter Axel Konstantinos. Certified bad boy, school delinquent, horrible grades and an F-tier reputation. He's the complete opposite of Adrian: impulsive, cocky, flirty, and reckless. He's someone Adrian does not want to cross paths with. But it's too late before Adrian realizes he's in too deep.

summary_text: On Terra, when people turn eighteen, they gain the opportunity to enter the Endless Sea. After passing the assessment, they can become an Island Holder, claim their own island, awaken extraordinary abilities, and embark on the extraordinary path. For countless young people, the Endless Sea is both an assessment and the beginning of a new life. But for Reed Newt, something goes terribly wrong. Due to a strange accident, Reed mistakenly believes that his assessment has turned into a genuine shipwreck. When he awakens on an unfamiliar island with nothing but the clothes on his back, he assumes that he has been stranded on a deserted island. And the vast, dangerous Endless Sea surrounding him. Just when Reed is on the verge of despair, the Survival System awakens. From that moment onward, surviving is no longer his only goal. Day after day, his tiny deserted island grows and continues to expand across the Endless Sea. Eventually, he stands proudly on the deck of his own ship, looking toward the countless islands scattered across the horizon. As Reed conquers island after island, the other candidates finally realize something is terribly wrong. Because the assessment hasn't even ended yet.

On Terra, when people turn eighteen, they gain the opportunity to enter the Endless Sea. After passing the assessment, they can become an Island Holder, claim their own island, awaken extraordinary abilities, and embark on the extraordinary path.

For countless young people, the Endless Sea is both an assessment and the beginning of a new life. But for Reed Newt, something goes terribly wrong. Due to a strange accident, Reed mistakenly believes that his assessment has turned into a genuine shipwreck. When he awakens on an unfamiliar island with nothing but the clothes on his back, he assumes that he has been stranded on a deserted island.

And the vast, dangerous Endless Sea surrounding him.

Just when Reed is on the verge of despair, the Survival System awakens. From that moment onward, surviving is no longer his only goal.

Day after day, his tiny deserted island grows and continues to expand across the Endless Sea. Eventually, he stands proudly on the deck of his own ship, looking toward the countless islands scattered across the horizon.

As Reed conquers island after island, the other candidates finally realize something is terribly wrong. Because the assessment hasn't even ended yet.

He did save them from the brink of death seven-hundred or so years ago, turning them into a vampire and keeping them under His wing ever since. There was never any place else to go, so why leave? The human world was terrible anyway. Everyone wanted them dead, or even worse, saw them as naive and easy. But still, there's this tiny spark of hope in the place where their heart should be, smoldering and aching. If they did kill Him... Solius ran away from home twenty-two years ago to the kingdom across the sea, after betraying its father and lineage. Complete blasphemy. Vampire are incapable of change. Which is why they should be eliminated immediately. It knew that well, but then research and experimentation was fine, right? In the pursuit of erasing vampirekind, in the pursuit of knowledge, it wasn't unreasonable, Solius rationalized. It's an odd choice, but Solius might just be the one Gumi's looking for to aid them. And Solius just might be willing to help.

summary_text: Princess Nyra Ravenscroft was twelve years old when she was stolen from her family in the dead of night. For a year, the youngest princess has been held captive in a secret facility, separated from her family and forced to suppress the strange power growing inside her. Her captors believe she possesses something far more dangerous than an ordinary ability-an ancient power capable of commanding the elements themselves. Then Nyra escapes. Weak, frightened, and unsure of how long she has been gone, she collapses in the wilderness, where three teenagers-Kael, Joss, and Selene-find her. They don't know she's a princess. They don't know why someone was holding her captive. And Nyra isn't willing to tell them. As the four grow closer, Nyra begins to discover the terrifying truth about her abilities-and why she was taken in the first place. But while Nyra builds a new family far from the palace, her own family has never stopped searching for her. When the lost princess finally returns, Nyra must face a kingdom that changed without her, a family she believed had forgotten her, and a power that may be far more dangerous than anyone ever imagined.

summary_text: The Otherworlders never came. In 1941, facing economic sanctions from the United States, the Empire of Japan resolves to go to war and opens hostilities against the US, Britain, the Netherlands, and Australia. While the Southern Operation and the attack on Pearl Harbor mark the beginning of the conflict, the Magitek Research Department, which had been preparing its military forces against a possible invasion from another world, finds that no such enemy appears. Instead, it joins the war as part of Japan’s military strength. The Magitek Research Department revives warships sunk during World War II—including the battleship Tosa , as well as Bismarck , Hood , and numerous aircraft carriers and other vessels—using technologies and magical techniques from another world. Armed with these resurrected weapons, it sails the world’s oceans in battle against the Allied powers. Thus, this alternate World War II follows a path different from that of real history…

summary_text: There are places that change you forever. For Isabel Navarro, it was the Marine Corps. Back in 2024, she enlisted in the Marine Corps believing hard work could earn her a place in the world. Boot camp was supposed to be 13 weeks of pain, discipline, and survival. Instead, she found a family in 100 strangers who became sisters, and she met Valeria Salazar, the brilliant recruit who seemed born to wear the uniform. By day, they were Marines in training. But once night came around, beneath whispered conversations, firewatch shifts, and the quiet hum of the squad bay after lights out, they became something neither of them expected. But all battles are emotional and mental more than they are physical. When duty, fear, and the lives they imagined for themselves begin pulling them in different directions, that loving someone and choosing them are not always the same thing.
